item.title: Use N8N to send emails with different contents and attachments
item.description: Recently, due to work needs, I hope to do a mass email, about 80,000 emails to different people, modify some content, and attach attachments. The principle is actually very simple. There are some existing projects on github that can be used, but the projects are very old and need to adjust the code. At the same time, some existing mass email tools are cloud-based, and the attachments I want to send actually want to be sent point-to-point, not uploaded to the cloud.
